# Synthetic PDF visual fixtures

F011 reuses `tests/fixtures/rich/synthetic.pdf`, a 612-byte redistributable one-page
PDF with a 612 × 792 point media box. Its SHA-256 digest is
`1c95c7b0f6c4a427559488b8f4825a424b6055bb201096ec28473ad4442a50e2`.

Rotation cases 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees are generated deterministically in memory by
`tests/unit/test_visual_pdfium.py` through the pinned PDFium writer. The exact F006
vector regions are generated by the 100-case integer corpus in
`tests/domain/test_visual_geometry.py`. Keeping generated variants out of the repository
avoids redundant binary fixtures while the source digest, dimensions and generation
recipe remain inspectable.
